EGFR and HER2 expression support prostate cancer progression to bone.

the mechanisms that regulate prostate cancer metastasis to bone and its resistance to therapy.
the identification of new therapeutic targets for the treatment of prostate cancer.
the molecular mechanisms that drive prostate cancer progression to bone.

HER2 is a marker for prostate cancer progression and metastasis to bone, and that EGFR is a marker for the survival of prostate cancer cells in the circulation and in bone metastasis.
HER2 and EGFER are both important in the progression of prostate cancer.

EGFR promotes the growth and survival of TICs, whereas HER2 promotes the growth of established metastases.
